name: noun_project
summary: Noun Project v2 REST connector — OAuth1 two-legged (consumer key + secret, no user context). Every icon harvested is FREE labeled training data: a curated text term, a tag list, a license string, and creator credits travel together with the SVG. Stdlib-only — OAuth1 signing implemented inline with hmac + hashlib + base64 + urllib (no `requests_oauthlib` dep). Each successful tool call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='noun_project_import', model='noun_project', scope=f'noun_project_<tool>'. harvest_query downloads each SVG to studio/assets/_corpus/icons/<crystal_short>.svg with a matching sidecar JSON.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp shape. SERVICE='noun_project'. urllib GET to api.thenounproject.com/v2/* with OAuth1 Authorization header. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() validates key+secret presence only — does NOT smoke-ping (free tier rate limit is tight).

env_vars.NOUNPROJECT_SECRET_KEY: OAuth1 consumer secret — must pair with NOUNPROJECT_API_KEY

convenience_wrappers: harvest_query(query, limit=10) — search + download SVG + sidecar JSON for every hit

corpus_layout.svg: <crystal_short>.svg — geometry_crystal[:16] of SVG bytes (svg_vector_embed if available else sha256)
corpus_layout.sidecar: <crystal_short>.json — { noun_id, noun_term, tags, use_cases, license, attribution, creator, crystal, svg_url_origin, saved_at, is_svg }
corpus_layout.dedup_thesis: Same icon re-harvested from different queries collapses to ONE record. Each new query gets appended to sidecar.use_cases. Same SVG from multiple creators collapses to ONE record (geometry_crystal dominates).

substrate: studio/assets/_corpus/icons/ (svg + json sidecar) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/noun_project_sends.jsonl (send history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored import records, tier='noun_project_import')

outbound_calls: <icon_url> CDN GETs (no auth needed for public icon CDN URLs)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: studio/assets/_corpus/icons/<crystal>.svg + <crystal>.json sidecars + send_log + crystal_chain import records

oauth1_implementation_notes.auth_header_format: OAuth oauth_consumer_key="...", oauth_nonce="...", oauth_signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", oauth_timestamp="...", oauth_version="1.0", oauth_signature="..."

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful import has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='noun_project_import'
Stdlib-only — no `requests_oauthlib` package required; OAuth1 signing inline (hmac + base64)
Graceful absent-keys — if NOUNPROJECT_API_KEY or NOUNPROJECT_SECRET_KEY missing, connect() returns False and send() emits SendResult(success=False, error='noun_project keys not configured')
Dedup-safe — same SVG re-harvested from different queries collapses by geometry_crystal/sha256; use_cases list grows additively
Sidecar-faithful — every saved SVG has a matching JSON sidecar capturing the curated text label, tags, license, and creator (training data, fully attributed)
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.noun_project import NounProjectConnector
c = NounProjectConnector()
c.connect()
r = c.send('harvest_query', '{"query":"arrow","limit":5}')
print(r.metadata['harvested'])  # list of saved svg paths
print(r.crystal_id)
